It should merge into the existing broader session initialization skills (741b0179 and aa70b4ce) which already cover the core init patterns. skill.name: AgentOps Client Initialization and Tracing
skill.description: Initialize the AgentOps client with auto-start session, create a named trace with tags, and instantiate the OpenAI client for agent execution. This skill sets up an instrumented agent session with tracing and monitoring capabilities.
skill.skill_body:
Call agentops.init() with auto_start_session=True, provide a trace_name and tags array. Then call agentops.start_trace() with the same trace_name and tags. Finally, instantiate the OpenAI client. Ensure environment variables OPENAI_API_KEY and AGENTOPS_API_KEY are loaded before initialization.

## Objective

Set up instrumented agent session with tracing and monitoring
## Applicable Signals

- Session start event
- Agent execution initiation
- Monitoring or tracing requirement detected

## Contraindications

- Running offline or local-only agent logic without monitoring requirements
- Testing without trace collection
- Environments where AgentOps API is unavailable or disabled

## Workflow Steps

- Load environment variables (OPENAI_API_KEY, AGENTOPS_API_KEY) via dotenv or equivalent
- Call agentops.init(auto_start_session=True, trace_name=<name>, tags=<list>)
- Call agentops.start_trace(trace_name=<name>, tags=<list>) and store tracer object
- Instantiate OpenAI client: client = OpenAI()

## Constraints

- OPENAI_API_KEY and AGENTOPS_API_KEY must be set in environment before calling init()
- agentops.init() must be called before agentops.start_trace()
- OpenAI client instantiation should follow trace setup

## Output Contract

- AgentOps client initialized with auto_start_session=True
- Active trace object created with trace_name and tags
- OpenAI client ready for downstream agent execution
